annotations.title: More works from the same owner

description: Use when the user asks: 'does this owner have anything similar?', 'any other songs like this from them?'. Typically while they are asking about licensing one song. Returns up to 9 of the SAME owner's other listed works that share this work's topics, genre or tempo, each with the reasons, and how many listed works the owner has in all. Never another owner's works. Nothing is sent: offer them to the user, and add any to directory_send_licensing_enquiry's also_work_ids only if the user explicitly says yes. Empty when the work is not listed or the owner is not taking enquiries. → then: directory_send_licensing_enquiry (with the user's go)

work_id.description: The work the user is asking about (UUID).
